body:
A few things to note here: 
First, I think there is value in the distinction between "this value is 30 because this was inherited from the default" or "this value is 30 because it was explicitly set to such", however when the override value happens to be the same as the default value there is currently no way to display that in the inspector. Even though it is supported. 
This is a really nasty behaviour because this "hidden override" can linger in a project for a very long time, until one time one decides to change the default again but some resources inexplicably decide to ignore that change.
(There especially needs to be a way to see and remove these hidden overrides.)

Lastly, that it displays the wrong value after changing the default value is just plain wrong, no way around it, that needs to be fixed.
